BlockDesc.XXXX0: I need some work at a {10} facility disrupted. I want someone to <style=DialogTerm>sabotage</style> it for me.
Dialog.D_PGen_Sabotage.1: It's a big project, and a team from {10} is putting a lot of effort into it.
Dialog.D_PGen_Sabotage.2: They want fast results and are pushing a little harder than they should.
Dialog.D_PGen_Sabotage.3: Some friends and I would like to slow them down. That would open some opportunities for us.
Dialog.D_PGen_Sabotage.4: Opportunities to beat them to the punch, or to embarrass them to their funders?
Dialog.D_PGen_Sabotage.5: You let us worry about that. All I want you to do is some sabotage.
Dialog.D_PGen_Sabotage.6: Take out some critical equipment or important shipment. That's all we need.
Dialog.D_PGen_Sabotage.7: Done right, it should take weeks to get back on schedule and will raise concerns about the whole plan.
Dialog.D_PGen_Sabotage.8: Damaging things sounds like an easy job. We will think about it.
Dialog.D_PGen_Sabotage.9_Male: {1} has offered a <style=DialogTerm>Sabotage</style> job. We need to reach a piece of equipment then spend 3 Turns working on it. We will be paid for successfully sabotaging the equipment.
Dialog.D_PGen_Sabotage.9_Female: {1} has offered a <style=DialogTerm>Sabotage</style> job. We need to reach a piece of equipment then spend 3 Turns working on it. We will be paid for successfully sabotaging the equipment.
M_PGen_Sabotage.MissionDesc.1.Male: A team from {10} is working on something that will interfere with {1}'s plans. {1} wants that project stopped for a while. Sabotage will slow them down.
M_PGen_Sabotage.MissionDesc.1.Female: A team from {10} is working on something that will interfere with {1}'s plans. {1} wants that project stopped for a while. Sabotage will slow them down.
M_PGen_Sabotage.RoomDesc: We have to find the right equipment and sabotage it.
BlockDesc.XXXX1: Hold the zone and sabotage the equipment for 3 full Turns
BlockDesc.XXXX2: Hold the zone and sabotage the equipment until the end of next Turn
BlockDesc.XXXX3: Hold the zone and sabotage the equipment until end of Turn
Dialog.D_PGen_Sabotage_Intro.2: We have to reach that equipment. It would be best if we can do it quietly.
Dialog.D_PGen_Sabotage_Intro.3: We will have to spend some time sabotaging the equipment once we get there.
Dialog.D_PGen_Sabotage_Intro.4: Too much attention could make finishing the sabotage tricky.
Dialog.D_PGen_Sabotage_Intro.5: Keep an eye out for the patrols. Let's get moving.
Dialog.D_PGen_Sabotage_Intro.6: We must reach the target zone next to the equipment. At least one of our team must take and hold the highlighted area for 3 Turns without any enemy contesting it.
Dialog.D_PGen_Sabotage_Done.1: That's it! The sabotage is done. They won't be able fix this for quite a while.
Dialog.D_PGen_Sabotage_Done.2: Time to get going. We can successfully extract now or continue to pillage this zone for more profit.
Dialog.D_PGen_Sabotage_Exit.1: Let's head home. See you at the Safehouse.
Dialog.D_PGen_Sabotage_Victory.1: Good job! The project is thrown into chaos. I knew you were the right crew for the task.
Dialog.D_PGen_Sabotage_Defeat.1: The security was too tight. We had to escape before completing the sabotage.
